name: claude-modes
description: The Modes program: the session store, mode and hook definitions, and the claude-modes command.

scripts.build: bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-arm64 src/main.ts --outfile dist/claude-modes-darwin-arm64 && bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-x64 src/main.ts --outfile dist/claude-modes-darwin-x64 && bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-linux-x64 src/main.ts --outfile dist/claude-modes-linux-x64 && bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-linux-arm64 src/main.ts --outfile dist/claude-modes-linux-arm64
